{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsorlift compensators''' were a type of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] device that helped to negate the weight of heavy items. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yutani]], a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and [[Heavy Weapons Specialists|Heavy Weapons Specialist]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]], used custom repulsorlift compensators that allowed him to move light [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] weapons with ease.<ref name="CCG-Yutani">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Captain Yutani}}</ref>
